description_en: Retrieves the status of a workflow draft and the nodes within it
description_zh: 获取工作流草稿以及工作流草稿中节点的状态
name: GetExperimentStatus

Nodes.description_en: The node statuses in the workflow draft
Nodes.description_zh: 工作流草稿中的节点状态

JobId.description_en: The workflow draft job ID created by the most recent run of the node
JobId.description_zh: 该节点最近一次运行创建的工作流草稿作业ID

NodeId.description_en: The node ID in the workflow draft

RunId.description_en: The ID of the PaiFlow PipelineRun created by the most recent run of the node
RunId.description_zh: 该节点最近一次运行创建的PaiFlow PipelineRun的ID

RunNodeId.description_en: The node ID in the PaiFlow PipelineRun that corresponds to the most recent run of the node
RunNodeId.description_zh: 该节点最近一次运行创建的PaiFlow PipelineRun中对应的节点ID

Status.description_en:
The task status. The status is consistent with the status in PaiFlow. Valid values:
Initialized: Initialization is complete.
Starting: The task is starting.
WorkflowServiceStarting: The task is being prepared for submission.
Running: The task is running.
Succeeded: The task succeeded.
Failed: The task failed.
Terminating: The task is being terminated.
Terminated: The task is terminated.
Unknown: The task status is unknown.
Skipped: The task is skipped because a preceding node failed.
ReadyToSchedule: The task is ready to run because a preceding node has not completed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态，状态和paiflow中状态一致，目前状态有：
Initialized: 初始化完成
Starting：开始
WorkflowServiceStarting：准备提交
Running：运行中
Succeeded：运行成功
Failed：运行失败
Terminating：终止中
Terminated：已终止
Unknown：未知
Skipped：跳过（前序节点失败导致）
ReadyToSchedule：准备运行（前序节点未完成导致）

Status.description_en:
The workflow draft status. Valid values:
Running: The workflow draft has running jobs.
Stopped: The workflow draft has no running jobs
Status.description_zh:
工作流草稿状态，目前有Stopped和Running两个状态：
Running：工作流草稿有运行中的作业。
Stopped：工作流草稿中没有运行中的作业
